sentences.en: Do you honestly think you still need that old hairdryer?
sentences.zh: 你真的认为你还需要那个旧吹风机吗？

sentences.en: Plug the hairdryer in and see if it still works.
sentences.zh: 插上吹风机的电源，看看它还能不能用。

sentences.en: Why didn't you just tell me you broke the hairdryer?
sentences.zh: 为什么你不直接告诉我你把吹风机弄坏了呢？
